name: Zoo Teens
what_you_do: Run games, crafts and animal activities at education stations in the zoo and teach guests about animals and conservation.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 19, 2.75 GPA (proof needed), letter of recommendation, interview, $35 program fee, mandatory in-person training Jan 10, 2027.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Cost to you: $35 program fee.
duration: Jan to April 2027. 3-hour weekend shifts, at least 2 shifts (6 hours) per month
deadline_text: Applications opened online Oct 10, 2026 for Zoo Teens 2027 (Jan to April). Closing date not stated.
how_to_apply: Apply online starting Oct 10, send a recommendation letter and proof of GPA, then interview with the volunteer coordinator.
notes: Mandatory in-person training Jan 10, 2027. The Summer Camp Counselor teen role (ages 15 to 19) is closed for 2026; check back next year. Animal Care Volunteers must be 18 or older.
